purpose: Teach: エンジェル/ルーマニア/ミレニアム/ギルド/ワイドショー/クリエイター/サイレント/ロフト

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがエンジェルの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he'll read you that Angel picture book.
lines.style: Warm, sharing something precious. Soft opening. Voice bright with the pleasure of delivering good news. Knowing tone — she's witnessed this kindness before.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとルーマニアの料理本を見たよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I looked through that book about Romanian cooking with Dad.
lines.style: Quick, eager pitch. Words tumble out with genuine excitement. Breathless with the need to share something back — matching her energy but smaller, more contained.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがミレニアム前後の歴史を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to teach you about the history around the year 2000.
lines.style: Gentle, almost conspiratorial. Taking her time with each phrase. The tone of someone sharing an opportunity she knows matters — tender but steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとギルド制度の社会科を勉強したよ
lines.en: Mei-san, Dad and I studied about guild systems in social studies.
lines.style: Proud but unboastful. Measured pace, clear enunciation. The slight formality of 'social studies' lands with quiet satisfaction — he's learned something real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがワイドショーの裏側を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed you what goes on behind the scenes of those variety shows.
lines.style: Indulgent, knowing smile in the voice. Slower pace — savoring the image of him sharing his world. A flicker of affection for how he includes Sho.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんがクリエイターのお仕事を見せて下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-san, Dad let me see what his work is like — the creative side of it.
lines.style: Glowing with the honor of being shown. Reverent but not stiff. The words carry the weight of access granted, of being trusted to understand something adult.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサイレント映画の名作を観せて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to show you those classic silent films.
lines.style: Unhurried, almost wistful. Each word placed with care. The voice of someone who recognizes a gift being passed down — from one generation through him to Sho.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの書斎、つまりロフトを見せて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, Dad showed me his study — the loft, I mean. He actually let me see it.
lines.style: Wonder-struck, slightly breathless. The correction 'the loft, I mean' lands naturally, intimately — he's remembering the space as he says it. Gratitude mixed with awe at the privilege.
